title: 'There will be elections in Venezuela,' interim leader tells UN

blocks.text: UNITED NATIONS, United States — Venezuela’s interim leader Delcy Rodriguez thanked US President Donald Trump for restoring diplomatic ties and told the United Nations on Wednesday that “there will be elections” in the Latin American country. Rodriguez replaced president Nicolas Maduro following his ouster by US forces in January, and she has served as a pliant ally to Washington since then. Addressing the UN General Assembly in New York, she thanked the Trump administration “for their willingness to resume the path of diplomatic relations and cooperation with Venezuela.” READ: Venezuela’s interim president: Who is Delcy Rodriguez? “I want to state this […]...
